172783.name: smn-1
172783.summary: Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; nematode pharyngeal pumping; and vulval development. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; excretory cell; hypodermis; intestine; and vulval muscle. Used to study spinal muscular atrophy. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Werdnig-Hoffmann disease; adult spinal muscular atrophy; intermediate spinal muscular atrophy; juvenile spinal muscular atrophy; and spinal muscular atrophy. Orthologous to human SMN1 (survival of motor neuron 1, telomeric) and SMN2 (survival of motor neuron 2, centromeric). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172814.name: cel-1
172814.summary: Enables polynucleotide 5'-phosphatase activity. Involved in polynucleotide 5' dephosphorylation. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in hypodermis; intestine; nervous system; pharynx; and tail. Orthologous to human RNGTT (RNA guanylyltransferase and 5'-phosphatase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172832.name: cox-5B
172832.summary: Involved in determination of adult lifespan; lipid storage; and proton motive force-driven mitochondrial ATP synthesis. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial envelope. Predicted to be part of respiratory chain complex IV. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Orthologous to human COX5B (cytochrome c oxidase subunit 5B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172839.name: nhr-49
172839.description: NR LBD domain-containing protein;Nuclear hormone receptor family member nhr-49
172839.otherdesignations: NR LBD domain-containing protein;Nuclear hormone receptor family member nhr-49
172839.nomenclaturename: NR LBD domain-containing protein;Nuclear hormone receptor family member nhr-49
172839.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan; positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and regulation of fatty acid metabolic process. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in hypodermis; intestinal cell; intestine; muscle cell; and neurons. Used to study alcohol use disorder and obesity. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Fanconi renotubular syndrome 4; familial combined hyperlipidemia; hypoglycemia; maturity-onset diabetes of the young type 1; and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to human HNF4A (hepatocyte nuclear factor 4 alpha) and HNF4G (hepatocyte nuclear factor 4 gamma). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172857.name: T23D8.3
172857.summary: Predicted to be involved in ribosomal small subunit biogenesis and ribosomal small subunit export from nucleus. Predicted to be part of preribosome, small subunit precursor. Predicted to be active in cytosol and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in inflammatory poikiloderma with hair abnormalities and acral keratoses. Orthologous to human LTV1 (LTV1 ribosome biogenesis factor). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172889.name: aha-1
172889.description: Aryl hydrocarbon receptor nuclear translocator homolog
172889.otherdesignations: Aryl hydrocarbon receptor nuclear translocator homolog
172889.nomenclaturename: Aryl hydrocarbon receptor nuclear translocator homolog
172889.summary: Enables DNA binding activity; DNA-binding transcription factor activity; and RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity. Contributes to sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and social behavior. Located in nucleus. Part of RNA polymerase II transcription regulator complex. Is expressed in several structures, including anal region; epithelial system; gonadal primordium; nervous system; and vulva. Used to study cardiovascular system disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in renal cell carcinoma. Orthologous to human ARNT (aryl hydrocarbon receptor nuclear translocator) and ARNT2 (aryl hydrocarbon receptor nuclear translocator 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172893.name: lin-11
172893.summary: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including axonal fasciculation; egg-laying behavior; and positive regulation of vulval development. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including B.pap; P5.p hermaphrodite; body wall musculature; egg-laying apparatus; and nervous system. Orthologous to human LHX1 (LIM homeobox 1) and LHX5 (LIM homeobox 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172896.name: wts-1
172896.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity and transcription coactivator binding activity. Involved in several processes, including apical protein localization; negative regulation of protein import into nucleus; and post-embryonic digestive tract morphogenesis. Located in apical plasma membrane and cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including anal depressor muscle; excretory canal; hypodermis; intestine; and reproductive system. Orthologous to several human genes including LATS1 (large tumor suppressor kinase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172917.name: blmp-1
172917.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including negative regulation of distal tip cell migration; positive regulation of nematode male tail tip morphogenesis; and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in cytoplasm. Is active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including distal tip cell; dorsal nerve cord; enteric muscle; hypodermis; and neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hepatocellular carcinoma and lung adenocarcinoma. Orthologous to human PRDM1 (PR/SET domain 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172920.name: pab-1
172920.summary: Enables mRNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including establishment of mitotic spindle localization; positive regulation of vulval development; and regulation of cell cycle process. Located in P granule and P-body. Is expressed in intestine and neurons. Orthologous to human PABPC1 (poly(A) binding protein cytoplasmic 1); PABPC1L (poly(A) binding protein cytoplasmic 1 like); and PABPC3 (poly(A) binding protein cytoplasmic 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172921.name: rpl-30
172921.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in determination of adult lifespan. Predicted to be part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in herpes simplex. Orthologous to human RPL30 (ribosomal protein L30). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172933.name: ndub-10
172933.summary: Predicted to be located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Predicted to be part of respiratory chain complex I. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in nuclear type mitochondrial complex I deficiency 35. Orthologous to human NDUFB10 (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase subunit B10). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172939.name: ndk-1
172939.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity and protein histidine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including negative regulation of axon regeneration; positive regulation of vulval development; and regulation of engulfment of apoptotic cell. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in several structures, including excretory cell; hypodermis; intestine; nervous system; and non-striated muscle. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in neuroblastoma; ovary epithelial cancer; and teratoma. Orthologous to several human genes including NME2 (NME/NM23 nucleoside diphosphate kinase 2) and NME1-NME2 (NME1-NME2 readthrough). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172943.name: rplp-0
172943.summary: Predicted to enable large ribosomal subunit rRNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic translation. Predicted to be part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Is expressed in several structures, including anal depressor muscle; germ line; intestine; nervous system; and somatic cell. Orthologous to several human genes including RPLP0 (ribosomal protein lateral stalk subunit P0). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172950.name: pash-1
172950.summary: Predicted to enable double-stranded RNA binding activity and primary miRNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including primary miRNA processing; regulation of epidermal cell differentiation; and regulation of vulval development. Predicted to be part of microprocessor complex. Is expressed in head; hypodermis; intestine; marginal cell; and pharyngeal muscle cell. Used to study chromosome 22q11.2 deletion syndrome, distal. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in alcohol dependence. Orthologous to human DGCR8 (DGCR8 microprocessor complex subunit). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172954.name: B0511.6
172954.summary: Predicted to enable several functions, including ATP binding activity; ATP hydrolysis activity; and RNA helicase activity. Predicted to be involved in maturation of LSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Predicted to be located in P granule. Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Is expressed in head; hypodermis; intestine; pharynx; and tail. Orthologous to human DDX18 (DEAD-box helicase 18). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172957.name: mrps-30
172957.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in translation. Predicted to be located in mitochondrion and ribosome. Predicted to be part of mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human MRPS30 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein S30). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

172966.name: lonp-1
172966.summary: Predicted to enable ATP-dependent peptidase activity and single-stranded DNA binding activity. Involved in protein catabolic process. Predicted to be active in mitochondrial matrix. Is expressed in several structures, including head; hypodermis; intestine; pharynx; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in CODAS syndrome. Orthologous to human LONP1 (lon peptidase 1, mitochondrial). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

172981.name: daf-16
172981.summary: Enables several functions, including 14-3-3 protein binding activity; DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; and enzyme binding activity. Involved in several processes, including defense response to bacterium; regulation of dauer larval development; and regulation of gene expression. Is active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including germ cell; germ line; gonad; hypodermis; and neurons. Used to study Parkinson's disease and diabetes mellitus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma. Orthologous to several human genes including FOXO1 (forkhead box O1) and FOXO3 (forkhead box O3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

173001.name: impt-1
173001.summary: Predicted to enable protein sequestering activity. Predicted to be involved in GCN2-mediated signaling; cellular response to amino acid starvation; and regulation of cytoplasmic translational initiation in response to stress. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in intestine. Orthologous to human IMPACT (impact RWD domain protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173005.name: dxbp-1
173005.description: DNA/RNA-binding protein Kin17 WH-like domain-containing protein
173005.otherdesignations: DNA/RNA-binding protein Kin17 WH-like domain-containing protein
173005.nomenclaturename: DNA/RNA-binding protein Kin17 WH-like domain-containing protein
173005.summary: Predicted to enable double-stranded DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in DNA damage response. Located in nucleolus. Is expressed in several structures, including somatic cell. Orthologous to human KIN (Kin17 DNA and RNA binding protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

173013.name: rsr-1
173013.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Predicted to be part of spliceosomal complex. Is expressed in hypodermis. Orthologous to human SRRM1 (serine and arginine repetitive matrix 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173041.name: timm-23
173041.description: Mitochondrial import inner membrane translocase subunit TIM23
173041.otherdesignations: Mitochondrial import inner membrane translocase subunit TIM23
173041.nomenclaturename: Mitochondrial import inner membrane translocase subunit TIM23
173041.summary: Predicted to enable mitochondrion targeting sequence binding activity and transmembrane protein transporter activity. Involved in protein import into mitochondrial matrix. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be part of TIM23 mitochondrial import inner membrane translocase complex. Is expressed in pharynx. Orthologous to several human genes including TIMM23 (translocase of inner mitochondrial membrane 23). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

173069.name: exo-3
173069.description: DNA-(apurinic or apyrimidinic site) endonuclease;exodeoxyribonuclease III
173069.otherdesignations: DNA-(apurinic or apyrimidinic site) endonuclease;exodeoxyribonuclease III
173069.nomenclaturename: DNA-(apurinic or apyrimidinic site) endonuclease;exodeoxyribonuclease III
173069.summary: Enables DNA-(apurinic or apyrimidinic site) endonuclease activity and phosphoric diester hydrolase activity. Involved in base-excision repair; embryo development; and nematode larval development. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in hermaphrodite gonad and male gonad. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in artery disease (multiple); breast cancer; female reproductive organ cancer (multiple); spina bifida; and urinary bladder cancer. Orthologous to human APEX1 (apurinic/apyrimidinic endodeoxyribonuclease 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173073.name: mag-1
173073.summary: Involved in several processes, including feminization of hermaphroditic germ-line; positive regulation of egg-laying behavior; and positive regulation of oogenesis. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Predicted to be part of catalytic step 2 spliceosome and exon-exon junction complex. Is expressed in head; pharynx; and tail. Orthologous to human MAGOHB (mago homolog B, exon junction complex subunit) and MAGOH (mago homolog, exon junction complex subunit). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173078.name: hsf-1
173078.summary: Enables several functions, including calmodulin binding activity; identical protein binding activity; and promoter-specific chromatin binding activity. Involved in several processes, including defense response to bacterium; positive regulation of catabolic process; and regulation of gene expression. Located in chromatin; cytoplasm; and nuclear stress granule. Is expressed in several structures, including germ cell; hypodermis; intestine; neurons; and somatic cell. Used to study neurodegenerative disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Huntington's disease; cataract; and cataract 5 multiple types. Orthologous to several human genes including HSF2 (heat shock transcription factor 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

173128.name: dlk-1
173128.description: Mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase dlk-1
173128.otherdesignations: Mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase dlk-1
173128.nomenclaturename: Mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase dlk-1
173128.summary: Enables ubiquitin protein ligase binding activity. Involved in several processes, including p38MAPK cascade; regulation of axon extension; and sprouting of injured axon. Located in neuronal cell body and synapse. Is expressed in PLML; PLMR; neurons; and pharynx. Orthologous to several human genes including MAP3K12 (mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 12). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

173134.name: atp-1
173134.summary: Enables enterobactin binding activity. Involved in iron import into cell. Located in mitochondrion. Is expressed in several structures, including anal depressor muscle; body wall musculature; intestine; pharynx; and tail. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency 22; mitochondrial complex V (ATP synthase) deficiency nuclear type 4A; and mitochondrial complex V (ATP synthase) deficiency nuclear type 4B. Orthologous to human ATP5F1A (ATP synthase F1 subunit alpha). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173227.name: gpi-1
173227.summary: Predicted to enable glucose-6-phosphate isomerase activity and monosaccharide binding activity. Predicted to be involved in gluconeogenesis; glucose 6-phosphate metabolic process; and glycolytic process. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is expressed in head; head neurons; intestine; and nervous system. Used to study Parkinson's disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital hemolytic anemia; congenital nonspherocytic hemolytic anemia; congenital nonspherocytic hemolytic anemia 4; intellectual disability; and neuromuscular disease. Orthologous to human GPI (glucose-6-phosphate isomerase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

173235.name: rpl-31
173235.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic translation. Predicted to be located in ribosome. Predicted to be part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Is expressed in body wall musculature; hypodermis; intestine; and pharynx. Orthologous to human RPL31 (ribosomal protein L31). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173237.name: cox-4
173237.summary: Involved in mitochondrial electron transport, cytochrome c to oxygen. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Predicted to be part of respiratory chain complex IV. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mitochondrial complex IV deficiency nuclear type 16. Orthologous to human COX4I1 (cytochrome c oxidase subunit 4I1) and COX4I2 (cytochrome c oxidase subunit 4I2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173260.name: rps-6
173260.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in determination of adult lifespan. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm; nucleolus; and ribosome. Predicted to be part of small-subunit processome. Orthologous to human RPS6 (ribosomal protein S6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173309.name: rps-20
173309.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in translation. Predicted to be located in ribosome. Predicted to be part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPS20 (ribosomal protein S20). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173325.name: ero-1
173325.summary: Predicted to enable protein-disulfide reductase activity. Involved in IRE1-mediated unfolded protein response and protein folding in endoplasmic reticulum. Predicted to be located in endoplasmic reticulum. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Orthologous to human ERO1A (endoplasmic reticulum oxidoreductase 1 alpha) and ERO1B (endoplasmic reticulum oxidoreductase 1 beta). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

173327.name: ttm-5
173327.summary: Predicted to enable sphingolipid delta-4 desaturase activity. Predicted to be involved in ceramide biosynthetic process. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in head neurons; nervous system; neurons; and tail neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hypomyelinating leukodystrophy 18. Orthologous to human DEGS1 (delta 4-desaturase, sphingolipid 1) and DEGS2 (delta 4-desaturase, sphingolipid 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

173332.name: gid-1
173332.summary: Predicted to enable protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. Is expressed in several structures, including anal depressor muscle; hypodermis; nervous system; oocyte; and reproductive system. Orthologous to human RANBP10 (RAN binding protein 10) and RANBP9 (RAN binding protein 9). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

173334.name: pbs-5
173334.summary: Predicted to enable endopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in proteasome-mediated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be part of proteasome core complex, beta-subunit complex. Predicted to be active in cytosol and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in proteasome-associated autoinflammatory syndrome 1. Orthologous to several human genes including PSMB5 (proteasome 20S subunit beta 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173342.name: rps-26
173342.summary: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in determination of adult lifespan. Predicted to be located in cytoplasmic side of rough endoplasmic reticulum membrane and ribosome. Predicted to be part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Diamond-Blackfan anemia 10. Orthologous to several human genes including RPS26 (ribosomal protein S26). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173349.name: mrps-27
173349.summary: Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Orthologous to human MRPS27 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein S27). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173362.name: ptr-23
173362.summary: Involved in endocytosis and molting cycle. Acts upstream of or within nematode male tail mating organ morphogenesis. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in cytoplasmic vesicle membrane and plasma membrane. Is expressed in hypodermis. Orthologous to human PTCHD3 (patched domain containing 3 (gene/pseudogene)) and PTCHD4 (patched domain containing 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173389.name: sptl-1
173389.summary: Predicted to enable serine C-palmitoyltransferase activity. Involved in establishment or maintenance of epithelial cell apical/basal polarity. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum. Is expressed in head and intestine. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hereditary sensory and autonomic neuropathy type 1A and juvenile amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 27. Orthologous to human SPTLC1 (serine palmitoyltransferase long chain base subunit 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173397.name: K10B4.3
173397.summary: Predicted to enable phosphatidylinositol-5-phosphate binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of signal transduction. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Orthologous to human VEPH1 (ventricular zone expressed PH domain containing 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173404.name: abu-11
173404.description: Activated in Blocked Unfolded protein response
173404.otherdesignations: Activated in Blocked Unfolded protein response
173404.nomenclaturename: Activated in Blocked Unfolded protein response
173404.summary: Involved in endoplasmic reticulum unfolded protein response. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Is expressed in pharyngeal muscle cell. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173425.name: D1069.3
173425.summary: Predicted to be involved in phosphatidylinositol phosphate biosynthetic process and protein localization to plasma membrane. Predicted to be located in cytosol. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hypomyelinating leukodystrophy 5. Orthologous to human HYCC1 (hyccin PI4KA lipid kinase complex subunit 1) and HYCC2 (hyccin PI4KA lipid kinase complex subunit 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

173436.name: tomm-22
173436.description: Mitochondrial import receptor subunit TOM22 homolog
173436.otherdesignations: Mitochondrial import receptor subunit TOM22 homolog
173436.nomenclaturename: Mitochondrial import receptor subunit TOM22 homolog
173436.summary: Predicted to contribute to transmembrane protein transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in protein import into mitochondrial matrix. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial outer membrane. Predicted to be part of mitochondrial outer membrane translocase complex. Orthologous to human TOMM22 (translocase of outer mitochondrial membrane 22). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

173437.name: nsun-1
173437.summary: Enables rRNA (cytosine-C5-)-methyltransferase activity. Involved in several processes, including negative regulation of cellular response to heat; negative regulation of locomotion involved in locomotory behavior; and positive regulation of egg-laying behavior. Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Is expressed widely. Used to study Williams-Beuren syndrome. Orthologous to human NOP2 (NOP2 nucleolar protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

173459.name: T02H6.11
173459.summary: Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial electron transport, ubiquinol to cytochrome c. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Predicted to be part of respiratory chain complex III. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in inherited metabolic disorder and mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 3. Orthologous to human UQCRB (ubiquinol-cytochrome c reductase binding protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173468.name: alg-2
173468.summary: Enables RNA binding activity and RNA endonuclease activity. Involved in embryo development; nematode larval development; and regulatory ncRNA-mediated gene silencing. Located in cytoplasm. Part of RISC complex. Is expressed in several structures, including germ line; gonad; hypodermis; neurons; and somatic cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in alcohol dependence and glaucoma. Orthologous to several human genes including AGO2 (argonaute RISC catalytic component 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173510.name: alh-6
173510.description: Aldehyde dehydrogenase domain-containing protein;L-glutamate gamma-semialdehyde dehydrogenase
173510.otherdesignations: Aldehyde dehydrogenase domain-containing protein;L-glutamate gamma-semialdehyde dehydrogenase
173510.nomenclaturename: Aldehyde dehydrogenase domain-containing protein;L-glutamate gamma-semialdehyde dehydrogenase
173510.summary: Predicted to enable L-glutamate gamma-semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity. Predicted to be involved in L-proline catabolic process. Predicted to be active in mitochondrial matrix. Is expressed in body wall musculature; head; hypodermis; and tail. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hyperprolinemia type 2. Orthologous to human ALDH4A1 (aldehyde dehydrogenase 4 family member A1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

173525.name: fdgt-1
173525.summary: Predicted to enable hexose transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in D-glucose transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in basolateral plasma membrane. Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in intestinal cell and pharyngeal muscle cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in childhood absence epilepsy; glucose metabolism disease (multiple); glycogen storage disease; myelomeningocele; and obesity. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC2A14 (solute carrier family 2 member 14) and SLC2A3 (solute carrier family 2 member 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173558.name: F52C6.2
173558.summary: Predicted to enable protein tag activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in modification-dependent protein catabolic process and protein ubiquitination. Predicted to be active in cytosolic ribosome and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

173744.name: rpn-11
173744.summary: Predicted to enable metal-dependent deubiquitinase activity and proteasome binding activity. Involved in programmed cell death involved in cell development. Predicted to be part of proteasome regulatory particle, lid subcomplex. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Orthologous to human PSMD14 (proteasome 26S subunit, non-ATPase 14). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173759.name: gpa-11
173759.summary: Predicted to enable G protein-coupled receptor binding activity; G-protein beta/gamma-subunit complex binding activity; and GTPase activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan and serotonin receptor signaling pathway. Predicted to be part of heterotrimeric G-protein complex. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in ganglia. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173763.name: sco-1
173763.summary: Predicted to enable copper chaperone activity and copper ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial respiratory chain complex IV assembly. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Used to study mitochondrial metabolism disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cytochrome-c oxidase deficiency disease; hypertrophic cardiomyopathy; mitochondrial complex IV deficiency nuclear type 2; mitochondrial complex IV deficiency nuclear type 4; and myopia. Orthologous to several human genes including SCO1 (synthesis of cytochrome C oxidase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

173764.name: gtf-2F1
173764.description: Transcription initiation factor IIF subunit alpha
173764.otherdesignations: Transcription initiation factor IIF subunit alpha
173764.nomenclaturename: Transcription initiation factor IIF subunit alpha
173764.summary: Predicted to enable RNA polymerase II general transcription initiation factor activity and TFIIF-class transcription factor complex binding activity. Predicted to be involved in transcription initiation at RNA polymerase II promoter. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Predicted to be part of transcription factor TFIIF complex. Orthologous to human GTF2F1 (general transcription factor IIF subunit 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173794.name: vab-1
173794.summary: Enables ephrin receptor activity and protein domain specific binding activity. Involved in several processes, including embryonic morphogenesis; oocyte maturation; and regulation of axon guidance. Located in axon and plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including neuroblasts; neurons; oocyte; seam cell; and somatic nervous system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 88; cataract 6 multiple types; central conducting lymphatic anomaly; pancreatic cancer; and prostate cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including EPHB4 (EPH receptor B4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173856.name: try-1
173856.summary: Predicted to enable serine-type peptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein processing. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in germ line. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive nonsyndromic deafness 8 and sensorineural hearing loss. Orthologous to several human genes including PRSS22 (serine protease 22); PRSS27 (serine protease 27); and PRSS33 (serine protease 33). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

173863.name: vps-24
173863.summary: Predicted to be involved in endosome transport via multivesicular body sorting pathway; late endosome to vacuole transport; and protein transport. Predicted to be part of ESCRT III complex. Predicted to be active in multivesicular body. Orthologous to human RNF103-CHMP3 (RNF103-CHMP3 readthrough) and CHMP3 (charged multivesicular body protein 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

173944.name: lys-8
173944.summary: Predicted to enable lysozyme activity. Involved in nematode pharyngeal gland morphogenesis. Is expressed in intestine; neurons; and pharyngeal gland cell. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

173954.name: ddl-1
173954.summary: Enables protein sequestering activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan. Located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including intestine; neurons; pharynx; spermatheca; and vulval muscle. Orthologous to human WASHC3 (WASH complex subunit 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

173960.name: mdt-26
173960.summary: Predicted to be located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

173963.name: ndub-5
173963.summary: Predicted to be located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Predicted to be part of respiratory chain complex I. Is expressed in hypodermis; intestine; and pharynx. Orthologous to human NDUFB5 (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase subunit B5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174002.name: frh-1
174002.summary: Predicted to enable 2 iron, 2 sulfur cluster binding activity; iron chaperone activity; and iron ion binding activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan; response to hydrogen peroxide; and response to superoxide. Located in mitochondrion. Is expressed in amphid neurons; body wall musculature; intestine; pharyngeal muscle cell; and spermatheca. Used to study Friedreich ataxia. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Friedreich ataxia; Friedreich ataxia 1; glioblastoma; and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to human FXN (frataxin). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174004.name: vrk-1
174004.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including cell fate specification; gonad development; and regulation of fibroblast growth factor receptor signaling pathway. Located in chromatin and nuclear envelope. Is expressed in several structures, including P3.p hermaphrodite; P4.p hermaphrodite; P5.p hermaphrodite; nervous system; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive distal hereditary motor neuronopathy 10 and pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 1A. Orthologous to several human genes including VRK1 (VRK serine/threonine kinase 1) and VRK2 (VRK serine/threonine kinase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174019.name: rbbp-5
174019.summary: Involved in several processes, including egg-laying behavior; heterochromatin organization; and transdifferentiation. Part of MLL3/4 complex. Orthologous to human RBBP5 (RB binding protein 5, histone lysine methyltransferase complex subunit). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174034.name: phb-2
174034.summary: Predicted to enable protein homodimerization activity. Involved in several processes, including defecation; mitophagy; and regulation of oxidative phosphorylation. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Part of mitochondrial prohibitin complex. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; excretory canal; intestine; nervous system; and pharynx. Orthologous to human PHB2 (prohibitin 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174045.name: set-4
174045.summary: Enables histone H4K20me methyltransferase activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan. Predicted to be located in chromosome and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including germ line; hypodermis; intestine; muscle cell; and neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 51. Orthologous to several human genes including KMT5C (lysine methyltransferase 5C). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174050.name: lgg-1
174050.summary: Predicted to enable GABA receptor binding activity; phosphatidylethanolamine binding activity; and ubiquitin protein ligase binding activity. Involved in several processes, including plasma membrane repair; positive regulation of autophagosome assembly; and xenophagy. Located in bounding membrane of organelle; neuron projection; and neuronal cell body. Is expressed in several structures, including egg-laying apparatus; germ cell; hypodermis; intestine; and nervous system. Orthologous to several human genes including GABARAP (GABA type A receptor-associated protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174058.name: lin-23
174058.description: F-box domain-containing protein;F-box/WD repeat-containing protein lin-23
174058.otherdesignations: F-box domain-containing protein;F-box/WD repeat-containing protein lin-23
174058.nomenclaturename: F-box domain-containing protein;F-box/WD repeat-containing protein lin-23
174058.summary: Enables beta-catenin binding activity and phosphatase binding activity. Involved in several processes, including negative regulation of centrosome duplication; regulation of protein stability; and ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Located in cytosol and nucleus. Part of cytoplasmic SCF ubiquitin ligase complex. Is active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including blast cell; body wall musculature; enteric muscle; germ line; and hypodermal cell. Orthologous to several human genes including FBXW11 (F-box and WD repeat domain containing 11). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174068.name: dgk-5
174068.summary: Predicted to enable ATP-dependent diacylglycerol kinase activity. Predicted to be involved in diacylglycerol metabolic process; intracellular signal transduction; and phosphatidic acid biosynthetic process. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Orthologous to human DGKI (diacylglycerol kinase iota) and DGKZ (diacylglycerol kinase zeta). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174121.name: egl-27
174121.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity; chromatin binding activity; and enzyme binding activity. Involved in several processes, including egg-laying behavior; hemidesmosome assembly; and nematode male tail tip morphogenesis. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including anal region; epithelial system; gonadal primordium; head; and tail. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in dentatorubral-pallidoluysian atrophy and schizophrenia. Orthologous to several human genes including RERE (arginine-glutamic acid dipeptide repeats). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174141.name: sod-1
174141.summary: Enables copper ion binding activity; protein homodimerization activity; and superoxide dismutase activity. Involved in regulation of brood size; regulation of vulval development; and removal of superoxide radicals. Located in cytosol and mitochondrion. Is expressed in several structures, including somatic gonad and somatic nervous system. Used to study amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Down syndrome; artery disease (multiple); eye disease (multiple); glucose metabolism disease (multiple); and neurodegenerative disease (multiple). Orthologous to human SOD1 (superoxide dismutase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174150.name: tcer-1
174150.summary: Predicted to enable RNA polymerase binding activity and transcription coregulator activity. Located in nuclear periphery. Is expressed in several structures, including germ cell; gonad; hypodermal cell; intestinal cell; and somatic cell. Orthologous to several human genes including TCERG1 (transcription elongation regulator 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174151.name: ZK1127.5
174151.summary: Predicted to enable RNA endonuclease activity. Predicted to be involved in endonucleolytic cleavage in 5'-ETS of tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA) and endonucleolytic cleavage in ITS1 to separate SSU-rRNA from 5.8S rRNA and LSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Predicted to be located in nucleolus. Predicted to be part of small-subunit processome. Is expressed in intestine and rectal gland cell. Orthologous to human RCL1 (RNA terminal phosphate cyclase like 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174155.name: cth-2
174155.summary: Predicted to enable cystathionine gamma-lyase activity and pyridoxal phosphate binding activity. Predicted to be involved in L-cysteine biosynthetic process and transsulfuration. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Is expressed in anal depressor muscle; body wall musculature; hypodermis; reproductive system; and vulval muscle. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in amino acid metabolic disorder and cystathioninuria. Orthologous to human CTH (cystathionine gamma-lyase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174161.name: kat-1
174161.summary: Predicted to enable acetyl-CoA C-acetyltransferase activity. Located in mitochondrion. Is expressed in body wall musculature; gonad; intestine; pharynx; and tail. Used to study obesity. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in beta-ketothiolase deficiency and carbohydrate metabolic disorder. Orthologous to human ACAT1 (acetyl-CoA acetyltransferase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174181.name: maoc-1
174181.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity. Involved in defense response to Gram-negative bacterium and innate immune response. Predicted to be located in peroxisomal membrane. Predicted to be active in peroxisome. Is expressed in intestine. Used to study obesity. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in D-bifunctional protein deficiency; Perrault syndrome; and Stiff-Person syndrome. Orthologous to human HSD17B4 (hydroxysteroid 17-beta dehydrogenase 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174203.name: hsp-4
174203.description: Endoplasmic reticulum chaperone BiP homolog;Heat shock 70 kDa protein D
174203.otherdesignations: Endoplasmic reticulum chaperone BiP homolog;Heat shock 70 kDa protein D
174203.nomenclaturename: Endoplasmic reticulum chaperone BiP homolog;Heat shock 70 kDa protein D
174203.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity. Involved in endoplasmic reticulum unfolded protein response. Located in rough endoplasmic reticulum. Is expressed in several structures, including PVD; hermaphrodite gonad; hypodermis; intestinal muscle; and intestine. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in dopamine beta-hydroxylase deficiency. Orthologous to human HSPA5 (heat shock protein family A (Hsp70) member 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174207.name: mtch-1
174207.summary: Predicted to be located in mitochondrial outer membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including enteric muscle; intestine; nervous system; pharynx; and rectal epithelium. Orthologous to human MTCH1 (mitochondrial carrier 1) and MTCH2 (mitochondrial carrier 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174225.name: nfi-1
174225.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; regulation of egg-laying behavior; and regulation of nematode pharyngeal pumping. Acts upstream of or within determination of adult lifespan. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; egg-laying apparatus; intestine; neurons; and pharynx. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Marshall-Smith syndrome; NFIA-related disorder; and Sotos syndrome 2. Orthologous to several human genes including NFIA (nuclear factor I A); NFIB (nuclear factor I B); and NFIC (nuclear factor I C). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174238.name: rpa-1
174238.description: putative replication factor A 73 kDa subunit
174238.otherdesignations: putative replication factor A 73 kDa subunit
174238.nomenclaturename: putative replication factor A 73 kDa subunit
174238.summary: Enables enzyme binding activity. Involved in positive regulation of nematode male tail tip morphogenesis. Located in nucleoplasm. Is expressed in germ line and pharynx. Orthologous to human RPA1 (replication protein A1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174242.name: nhx-2
174242.summary: Enables sodium:proton antiporter activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; positive regulation of growth rate; and regulation of nematode pharyngeal pumping. Located in apical plasma membrane. Is expressed in intestine. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 19; congenital secretory sodium diarrhea 8; cystic fibrosis; end stage renal disease; and exocrine pancreatic insufficiency. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC9A3 (solute carrier family 9 member A3) and SLC9A5 (solute carrier family 9 member A5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174265.name: cec-3
174265.summary: Predicted to enable chromatin binding activity. Involved in negative regulation of gene expression. Located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174267.name: lin-5
174267.summary: Enables dynein complex binding activity. Involved in several processes, including gonad development; microtubule cytoskeleton organization; and regulation of protein localization. Located in cell cortex; condensed chromosome; and spindle. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174289.name: ubh-4
174289.summary: Enables cysteine-type deubiquitinase activity. Involved in negative regulation of proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process and protein deubiquitination. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in intestine; muscle cell; and neurons. Orthologous to human UCHL5 (ubiquitin C-terminal hydrolase L5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174305.name: ire-1
174305.summary: Predicted to enable RNA endonuclease activity; protein serine/threonine kinase activity; and unfolded protein binding activity. Involved in IRE1-mediated unfolded protein response; nematode larval development; and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Is active in neuronal cell body. Is expressed widely. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hepatocellular carcinoma. Orthologous to several human genes including ERN2 (endoplasmic reticulum to nucleus signaling 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174311.name: rpl-10L
174311.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in translation. Predicted to be located in ribosome. Predicted to be part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Is expressed in several structures, including excretory cell; hypodermis; intestine; non-striated muscle; and pharynx. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autistic disorder; spermatogenic failure 63; and syndromic X-linked mental retardation 35. Orthologous to human RPL10 (ribosomal protein L10) and RPL10L (ribosomal protein L10 like). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174312.name: tub-1
174312.summary: Involved in positive regulation of neurogenesis and receptor localization to non-motile cilium. Located in cytoplasm; non-motile cilium; and periciliary membrane compartment. Is expressed in neurons. Used to study obesity. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Leber congenital amaurosis 15; retinitis pigmentosa; and retinitis pigmentosa 14. Orthologous to several human genes including TUB (TUB bipartite transcription factor) and TULP3 (TUB like protein 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174313.name: pch-2
174313.summary: Predicted to enable ATP binding activity and ATP hydrolysis activity. Predicted to be involved in meiotic recombination checkpoint signaling and reciprocal meiotic recombination. Located in kinetochore. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 3. Orthologous to human TRIP13 (thyroid hormone receptor interactor 13). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174314.name: emb-27
174314.summary: Predicted to enable enzyme-substrate adaptor activity. Involved in asymmetric cell division; eggshell formation; and polarity specification of anterior/posterior axis. Located in synapse. Is expressed in GABAergic neurons. Orthologous to human CDC16 (cell division cycle 16). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174318.name: cct-1
174318.summary: Predicted to enable unfolded protein binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein folding. Located in nucleus. Part of chaperonin-containing T-complex. Is expressed in several structures, including hypodermis; intestine; nervous system; pharynx; and vulva. Orthologous to human TCP1 (t-complex 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174322.name: ifg-1
174322.summary: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity and translation initiation factor activity. Predicted to be involved in translational initiation. Predicted to be part of eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4F complex. Is expressed in several structures, including gonad. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in late onset Parkinson's disease. Orthologous to several human genes including EIF4G3 (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4 gamma 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174330.name: cct-4
174330.summary: Predicted to enable unfolded protein binding activity. Involved in post-embryonic body morphogenesis. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be part of chaperonin-containing T-complex. Is expressed in several structures, including head; intestine; pharynx; rectal gland cell; and touch receptor neurons. Orthologous to human CCT4 (chaperonin containing TCP1 subunit 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174333.name: hel-1
174333.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan; nuclear mRNA surveillance; and positive regulation of gene expression. Located in nucleus. Part of transcription regulator complex. Is expressed in several structures, including anal depressor muscle; intestine; nervous system; pharynx; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in type 1 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to several human genes including DDX39A (DExD-box helicase 39A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174387.name: eif-2Bepsilon
174387.description: Translation initiation factor eIF2B subunit epsilon
174387.otherdesignations: Translation initiation factor eIF2B subunit epsilon
174387.nomenclaturename: Translation initiation factor eIF2B subunit epsilon
174387.summary: Predicted to enable guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity; translation initiation factor activity; and translation initiation factor binding activity. Predicted to be involved in translational initiation. Predicted to be located in cytosol. Predicted to be part of eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2B complex. Is expressed in several structures, including anal depressor muscle; nervous system; pharyngeal-intestinal valve; rectal gland cell; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in leukoencephalopathy with vanishing white matter and leukoencephalopathy with vanishing white matter 5. Orthologous to human EIF2B5 (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2B subunit epsilon). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]
